title: Home Mortgage Loans: Per-Program Loan Allowance and Funding Window
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Per-Program Loan Allowance and Funding Window

Two program-level figures for Home Mortgage Loans are collected on this card. The first is how many loans of one program a single customer may hold at once while those loans are still open in any sense — applied for, active, delinquent or in forbearance. The second is the span of calendar days, counted from the application, inside which a loan has to close.

| Program | Loans of this program a customer may hold (applied, active, delinquent or in forbearance) | Funding window (calendar days after application) |
|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1 | 60 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1 | 60 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 60 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 | 60 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 2 | 60 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 | 75 |

## Notes on the figures

- The allowance is a whole-number count per program. A loan that has been paid off, or an application that ended as withdrawn, is not in any of the four open statuses named above.
- The funding window is expressed in calendar days, not business days. Five programs allow 60 days; the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage alone allows 75.

## Quick answers

**How many Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage loans may one customer have open together?** Up to 3.

**Is the funding window longer for any program?** Yes, the jumbo program, at 75 calendar days against 60 for the others.
